_about: Tunables for scripts/security/dast_ingress_sweep.py (ADR 0155, increment 2, ingress plane). Every floor is a MINIMUM with headroom under a measured value; below one the run exits 2 (could not measure), never 0. Every resource bound is a MAXIMUM with headroom over a measured value. Raise a floor when the real number grows; NEVER lower a floor or raise a bound to make a run pass.

_provenance.measured: 2026-09-26 on Windows 11 against branch b100-dast-ingress (origin/main 58f15e31f merged with ddbfc16a6), seed 318, 24 mutations
_provenance.remeasured_why: The first measurement the same day (mllp 57 cases, 81 frames, 41 NAKs) was taken before the code review corrected the mutation corpus (a sentinel-bearing seed added, X12 mutations kept off the ISA) and the at-cap case (it was one byte over). Those numbers were a property of the old corpus, so the floors were re-cut from this measurement, not lowered to pass a run.
_provenance.cases_per_plane: measured mllp 58 (40 catalogue + 18 mutations), tcp 9, x12 15 (9 catalogue + 6 mutations)
_provenance.min_frames_decoded: measured tcp 7 and x12 9 (6 catalogue + 3 mutation)
_provenance.min_mllp_rejected_replies: measured 10 (8 catalogue) before engine PR 1583, 14 after it, because a decoded blank segment is now NAKed; the floor sits at the catalogue's own 8 so a mutation draw cannot trip it
_provenance.min_log_records_seen: measured 32 INFO+ engine records; the floor only proves the watch was fed
_provenance.resource_bounds: measured heap growth between -50695 and +19628 bytes, handles +0 to +2, tasks +0 over 2 passes across four runs; the leak canary measured heap +8413697 and handles +32
_provenance.wall_seconds: measured about 7 for the seeded run

known_defects.blank-segment: Engine defect found by this pass on 2026-09-26, still open: an HL7 frame that decodes as UTF-8 and carries an empty segment (a bare CR run) makes the MLLP pre-ACK read raise IndexError before the ingress row. Since engine PR 1583 (BACKLOG #1619, commit 4f40f3f6e) the listener answers that fault with an AE NAK and closes the connection, but no row is written, so the NAKed message is never recorded. Only this face is tolerated. The face that FAILS UTF-8 decode was fixed by the same commit (recorded ERROR, then NAKed) and is asserted, not tolerated. Frames pipelined after either face go unanswered because the listener closes by design after a handler fault. Open engine PR 1579 fixes the root cause. Pinned by a strict xfail in tests/test_dast_ingress_sweep.py.
known_defects.alphanumeric-field-separator: Engine defect found by this pass on 2026-09-26: a message whose MSH-1 is a letter or digit is accepted, and the ACK echoes that separator, so MSA-1 (AA/AE/AR, themselves letters) cannot be read back by the sender. Pinned by a strict xfail in tests/test_dast_ingress_sweep.py.

canary._cases_note: listener-down runs only the first two: every probe after the stop costs connect_seconds, and two refused probes plus one refused case already clear its floor.
